credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of O'Keeffe standing in the corner of her Abiquiu studio looking downward with her hand on the window sill. Her hair is pulled back and she is wearing a black sweater and two piece matching shirt and skirt. Visible on the window sill is a jawbone and dried out Cholla branch.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Abiquiu Studio
